grammar_focus: KS38 过去完成时(had done)与过去完成进行时(had been doing)的区别(教材 L62 Key structures)主考;宾语从句中主句过去→从句用过去完成 + SD 易混词 control/check、great/big、soil/ground(辅考)
scene: 消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才最后把火势控制住。就在不久之前,参天大树还覆盖着方圆数英里的土地。而现在,发热的地面上仍然升腾着烟雾,弥漫在荒凉的山丘上。冬季即将来临,这些山丘对周围的村庄具有毁灭性的威胁,因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤,而且还会引起严重的水灾。在大火最后被扑灭后,森林管理当局订购了好几吨一种生长迅速的特殊类型的草籽。飞机把这种草籽大量地撒播在地上。飞机撒播近一个月后,开始下起雨来。然而到那时,很多地方的草已经生了根。一片片的绿草开始出现在这片烧焦的土地上,代替了那多少世纪以来一直生长在那里的参天大树。

grammar_card.title: 过去完成时 vs 过去完成进行时
grammar_card.intro: KS38 两种时态都表示“过去的过去”,区别在于:①过去完成时 had + 过去分词——表示到过去某时已经完成的动作,常与 before/already/by then 连用(He had already finished work before I arrived);②过去完成进行时 had been + 现在分词——强调到过去某时为止一直持续的过程,常与 for + 时段连用(He had been working in a factory for years before he got this job)。

rows: He had already finished work before I arrived.
He had been working here for years before he got this job.
I asked him what he had lost.
I asked him what he had been doing all afternoon.

specialRules.rule: 在 before/after/when 等连接的两个过去动作中,先发生的用过去完成时,后发生的用一般过去时:When the fire had been put out, the authorities ordered grass-seed。
SD 易混词:control=掌管/控制(controls a company) vs check=检查/查验(checked my car engine);great=伟大/重要的(a great composer) vs big=(体积)大的(big buildings);soil=土壤(grow in poor soil) vs ground=地面(fell to the ground)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
options: Heavy rain would wash away the soil and cause serious floods
The smoke would poison the air

passage: Firefighters had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control. A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around. Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills. Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well. When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly. The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by airplanes. The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain. By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root. In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.

grammar_points.name: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词
过去完成进行时 had been + 现在分词
宾语从句中的过去完成(had done / had been doing)

stage5.stem: "A short time before, great trees ___ the countryside for miles around."(过去完成时:过去的过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 就在不久之前,参天大树还覆盖着方圆数英里的土地。

stage5.stem: "He ___ already finished work before I arrived."(过去完成时,before + 一般过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 我到达之前他已经完成了工作。

stage5.stem: "By then, in many places the grass ___ already taken root."(过去完成时,by then)
stage5.stem_cn: 到那时,很多地方的草已经生了根。

stage5.stem: "He ___ in Scotland for fifteen years before he came to England."(过去完成时,before + 过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 他来英格兰之前在苏格兰住了15年。

stage5.stem: "Firefighters ___ the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control."(过去完成进行时:强调持续过程)
stage5.stem_cn: 消防员同大火搏斗了将近3个星期才控制住。

stage5.stem: "The planes ___ seed for nearly a month when it began to rain."(过去完成进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 飞机撒播了近一个月草籽,这时开始下起雨来。

stage5.stem: "In place of the great trees which ___ there for centuries, patches of green appeared."(过去完成进行时,for centuries)
stage5.stem_cn: 代替了那多少世纪以来一直生长在那里的参天大树。

stage5.stem: "I asked him what he ___."(宾语从句:主句过去,'丢了什么'用过去完成时)
"I asked him what he ___ all afternoon."(宾语从句:'整个下午一直在做什么'用过去完成进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 我问他整个下午在干什么。

stage5.stem: "The inspector ___ my ticket."(易混词:检票员'查验'我的票)
"He ___ a large business company."(易混词:'掌管、控制'一家公司)
stage5.stem_cn: 他掌管着一家很大的商业公司。

stage5.stem: "Have you ___ those figures?"(易混词:'核对'那些数字)
stage5.stem_cn: 你核对过那些数字了吗?

stage5.stem: "Beethoven was a ___ composer."(易混词:'伟大的'作曲家)
stage5.stem_cn: 贝多芬是一位伟大的作曲家。

stage5.stem: "Skyscrapers are ___ buildings."(易混词:'高大的'楼房,指体积)
stage5.stem_cn: 摩天大楼是高大的楼房。

stage5.stem: "The Parthenon is a ___ building — an important one."(易混词:'重要/伟大的'建筑)
stage5.stem_cn: 巴台农神殿是一座重要的建筑。

stage5.stem: "Olive trees can grow in poor ___."(易混词:'土壤'——供植物生长的养分层)
stage5.stem_cn: 橄榄树能在贫瘠的土壤里生长。

stage5.stem: "The ball fell to the ___."(易混词:'地面')
"Nothing can grow in this poor ___."(易混词:'土壤')
stage5.stem_cn: 这贫瘠的土壤里什么也长不出来。
